eohippus: n. earliest horse; extinct primitive dog-sized four-toed Eocene animal
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自 eo- ＋ -hippus。</dd></dl>
eon:
n. the longest division of geological time
n. an immeasurably long period of time

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；(US) 標籤指美式拼法，英式多拼作 aeon</dd><dt>詞根詞綴</dt><dd>拉丁／希臘 aion「時代、年代」</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>over the eons；in eons</dd><dt>近義詞</dt><dd>ages：同樣可誇張地表示「很久」，日常更常用，如 for ages</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">I haven't seen you in eons 是誇張說法，意思是「好久不見」</dd></dl>
eosin:
n. 曙紅色染料
[化] 曙紅; 酸性曙紅; 四溴熒光素
n. a red fluorescent dye resulting from the action of bromine on fluorescein; used in cosmetics and as a biological stain for studying cell structures
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">國際科學詞彙 eos-（源自希臘語 ēōs（黎明））＋ -in, -ine；最初以德語 eosin 形式構成；得名於它賦予絲綢的顏色——另見 east。</dd></dl>
eosinophil: [醫] 嗜曙紅細胞, 嗜酸性細胞
n. a leukocyte readily stained with eosin
eosinophilia: [醫] 嗜曙紅細胞增多, 嗜曙紅性
n. a symptom of allergic states; increased eosinophils in the blood
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自國際科學詞彙 eosinophile ＋ 新拉丁語 -ia。</dd></dl>
eosinophilic: [醫] 嗜曙紅的, 嗜酸性的
a. of or relating to eosinophil
